verdict.rationale: Runloop's marketing site explicitly claims a documented cold-start metric ("10GB image startup time in <2s", supporting 10k+ parallel sandboxes), and docs also describe quickstart getting a devbox running in ~1 minute and suspend/resume for fast state recovery. However, this is a single marketing-page claim rather than a detailed benchmark methodology, and there's no independent or hands-on corroboration of actual cold-start latency across image sizes. Missing for 10: reproducible benchmark methodology/independent verification, breakdown of cold-start times across different image sizes/configs, third-party performance reports.
